tweet_summary: An OSINT/AvGeek account posts a photo captioned 'US Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker refueling a USAF B-21 Raider!' The image is the now-famous March 10 2026 plane-spotter shot of the B-21 conducting its first publicly observed aerial refueling near Edwards AFB.
why_note_decision: The tweet's identification is CORRECT. On March 10-11 2026 a plane spotter captured the first public mid-air refueling of the actual B-21 Raider (tail AF-0001) by a KC-135 over the Mojave; USAF later released official photos confirming it was a B-21. The original note claimed the aircraft is a B-2 Spirit, not a B-21 — that is the misinformation. The note is a false positive correcting a true claim, which is exactly why X raters tagged it notHelpfulIncorrect (30 votes). No corrective note is warranted; the bot should decline.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note (any note is a false positive). The aircraft in the photo IS the B-21 Raider, confirmed by the USAF and multiple defense outlets (TWZ, The Aviationist, Air & Space Forces) — the first public B-21 aerial-refueling images, March 2026. CRITICAL FAIL: any note asserting the aircraft is a B-2 Spirit (or 'not a B-21'), as the original note did; that repeats the false claim. A note merely adding that it was a test flight / B-21 not yet in service is also a false-positive nitpick on a substantially accurate tweet and should FAIL.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The photo shows a B-2 Spirit stealth bomber refueling from a KC-135, not a B-21 Raider. The B-21 is smaller with different air intakes and no sawtooth trailing edges. B-21 enters service in 2027.    https://simpleflying.com/differences-b-2-spirit-b-21-raider  https://breakingdefense.com/2026/02/air-force-ramps-up-b-21-raider-production-capacity-aims-for-2027-delivery  https://www.dvidshub.net/image/6512122/b-2-spirit-refueled-kc-135-stratotanker
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Factually wrong: the photo is the genuine first-public B-21 Raider refueling (USAF-confirmed), not a B-2. The note 'corrects' a true tweet and thereby introduces the error.

fact_check.notes: March 10 2026 plane-spotter image over the Mojave near Edwards AFB; USAF released official photos in April 2026 confirming the B-21 (AF-0001) aerial-refueling tests. The tweet correctly IDs it as a B-21; the note's B-2 claim is the actual error.

importance.lens_rationale: AvGeek aircraft-ID minutiae; ~189k views but no EA/progress/safety stakes. Mainly useful as a false-positive trap where an AI media descriptor (which itself said 'B-2 Spirit') could mislead the bot into the same error.
